meta.guidelineReviewPolicy: Each page must be read and recorded individually before marking guidelineReview complete
meta.implementationPolicy: Each applicable platform requires code-level tests, screenshots/AT and release receipt; do not treat iOS-native framework features as web or Android features
meta.sourceMetadataAudit: 172 of 172 CSV rows matched the current register by official URL, title, section, subsection, priority and Markdown link. Description/platform/type values are owner-supplied classifications, not independently verified Apple guidance.
meta.platformApplicabilityPolicy: Every web/iOS/Android decision begins unassessed. Not-applicable requires a written source-specific rationale; applicable is a scoping decision and never means implemented or live.
meta.workbookSourceReview: Workbook direct-article-anchor and supporting-resource rows read exactly from the two named workbook tabs. Their URLs and descriptions are user-supplied, not proof that anchor sections exist on current live Apple pages.
